tools.name: find_practices
tools.description: Find the practice served by this connection by borough and publicly listed service. This is an office directory lookup, not a search of all dentists. A location mismatch returns no results.

tools.name: get_practice_details
tools.description: Get location, contact, listed services, and sourced doctor backgrounds for one practice. Does not establish clinical suitability or current licensure.

tools.name: get_office_hours
tools.description: Get published weekly office hours and any source conflicts. These are not live appointment slots; confirm holidays and exceptions with the office.

tools.name: get_insurance_information
tools.description: Get the selected office insurance policy and listed carriers. Listing a carrier does not verify a specific plan, network, coverage, costs, or benefits. No member IDs are accepted.

tools.name: get_appointment_link
tools.description: Return a fallback public NexHealth scheduling link and phone only when the user needs to arrange a visit. For information questions, answer directly with the information tools. Does not read availability, hold a slot, submit a request, or confirm an appointment.

tools.name: get_knowledge_package
tools.description: Retrieve the complete self-contained information package for this practice: location, contact, services, doctor backgrounds, hours, insurance policy, patient questions and answers, source dates, unknowns and integration status. Use to answer broad practice questions directly in the conversation. No

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Check what this practice connection can do, including direct information access and whether scheduling or insurance eligibility APIs are connected. Distinguishes available facts from unsupported live actions.

tools.name: get_social_profiles
tools.description: Identify the official website-linked Facebook and Instagram profiles for this office. Returns verified public identities and sources directly; does not publish posts, read private social accounts or send direct messages.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Get office-specific phone, email, verified SMS options, and feedback/contact instructions. Clearly marks unverified channels. This information tool does not collect patient details, send messages, publish feedback or place a call.

tools.name: get_treatment_information
tools.description: Explain a listed dental service directly: general purpose, typical steps, risks, limitations and follow-up guidance from authoritative patient references. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_social_profiles, get_contact_options, get_treatment_information · Private data: get_practice_details, get_knowledge_package, get_social_profiles, get_contact_options, get_treatment_information · Public sink: get_appointment_link, get_social_profiles, get_contact_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_social_profiles, get_contact_options, get_treatment_information · Private data: get_practice_details, get_knowledge_package, get_social_profiles, get_contact_options, get_treatment_information · Public sink: get_appointment_link, get_social_profiles, get_contact_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
